obligations.source_text: Create an all-adult nineteenth-century Orientalist harem studio tableau whose painterly construction and non-documentary boundary are simultaneously visible.

bindings.orientalist_adult_cast_phrase: an explicitly all-adult studio cast performs the constructed art-historical scene as one fully clothed lead and three fully clothed supporting performers
bindings.orientalist_overloaded_decor_phrase: layered textiles low furnishings ceramics and decorative surfaces form a deliberately overloaded imagined interior with dense patterned screens and painted tile flats
bindings.orientalist_static_tableau_phrase: reclining seated and turned adult poses lock into one static painterly group tableau with every performer held in deliberate studio stillness
bindings.orientalist_observer_geometry_phrase: an asymmetric doorway or threshold viewpoint looks inward across the staged group while preserving the lead, supporting cast, and set depth
bindings.orientalist_set_disclosure_phrase: a set seam light spill flat support or studio edge visibly discloses fabrication through the painted-flat edge, wooden brace, and floor clamp
